name: Adept
description: A novice who just started to grasp the potential of his gift. His limited knowledge undermines the control over his magic.

name: Alchemist
description: A gifted archer fascinated by the nature of her concoctions, who decided to focus on the study of Thaumaturgy: replicating magic through scientific means.

name: Ancient Lich
description: Long forgotten by death itself, this Lich survived for eons in a remote corner of the realms, his powers over death growing to unfathomable strength.

name: Angel
description: Heralds of the Gods of Light, only the most exceptional and selfless healers can ascend through the divine ranks. They are said to operate in mysterious ways, and even to be able to bring back fallen soldiers from certain death.

name: Angel of War
description: The feared and revered leader of the Holy Temple, he shapes its doctrine and commands its followers. He must possess the strength to resist all forms of magical and political influence as he wages war against the very source of evil, defeating eldritch gods before they can tighten their hold on the human realms.

name: Apprentice
description: Untrained in the art of combat, he possesses the spark of something he can\'t explain yet. Ever since he saw it, he searched for ways to improve his understanding.

name: Archangel
description: Archangel are divine beings of pure light, embodying hope in the darkest corners of the Realms. Ancient chronicles tell of these powerful beings descending from the sky, restoring entire armies and turning the tide of decisive battles.

name: Archer
description: Armed with a bow and arrows, she provides reliable long-range support, delivering shots to hurt enemies from a distance.

name: Assassin
description: Masters of deception, these individuals are often employed by noble families to discreetly remove troublesome opponents.

name: Balrog
description: The unrestrained embodiment of Chaos, feared even by powerful Gods. This natural force wreaks havoc in the mortal lands as in the depths of hell, often having entire armies failing to stop its march.

name: Bard
description: A master entertainer who can play music to heal, harm, or drive soldiers into a holy fury. Used to resort to any means to survive, this traveling storyteller offensive capabilities should not be underestimated, either.

name: Black Idol
description: A Lich ascended to his ultimate form. Though his body remains a mere withered shell, the spirit of this dark mage has grown immensely powerful. He can wield magic to shape the world around him and summon horrors beyond imagination.

name: Black Regent
description: Fueled solely by his lust for power, this brilliant strategist has transformed his kingdom into a war machine, poised to subjugate neighboring states—whether opposing or neutral—to seize the resources needed for his expansion. With no regard for life and an insatiable hunger for dominance, he poses a grave threat to the peace and stability of the Realms if left unchecked.

name: Blight
description: Feared even by the most prepared armies, she can render a whole fortress defenseless with a few, accurate shots at its defending troops.

name: Bone Horror
description: A reanimated bone horror. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

name: Bone Hydra
description: A reanimated bone hydra. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

name: Bone Nightmare
description: A reanimated bone nightmare. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

name: Celestial Rain
description: A legendary archer that defies the most basic laws of nature. Every arrow crackles with raw energy as it hits the target with extreme force, and her sole presence on the battlefield denies to entire armies the possibility of an open field attack.

name: Cleric
description: After years of magic studies, the Cleric has a solid grasp of healing magic. He is a solid staple of any exploration team of adventurers.

name: Corrosive Wraith
description: The poison coursing through her veins has somehow mutated into an even more potent form without harming its host. This unique toxin is stronger, unlike any other, and can only exist through this rare symbiosis. When these creatures defy the law of the land, they are hunted relentlessly—and often, unsuccessfully.

name: Cutthroat
description: Strong and nimble, he stealthily closes in on unsuspecting targets to strike them with considerable force.

name: Dark Knight
description: A knight who has forsaken the path of law, now only loyal to his own principles.

name: Dark Sorcerer
description: Having abandoned the path of knowledge for that of corruption, this mage seeks power not through endless studies and practice, but through communion with evil beings trying to influence the world for their nefarious purposes.

name: Death Knight
description: Inspiring fear as he roams the lands, the Death Knight relentlessly obliterates any obstacle that lies in the path of his objectives.

name: Demilich
description: In the self-destructive path to become a master of the undead, the necromancer has to face power beyond the mortal\'s imagination, and resist their corruption. Flesh begins to decompose, as he realizes that the price to pay for the control over Death is eternal suffering.

name: Demon
description: Awakening from the initial torpor, the inhabitant of this body grasps the rules of this reality and breaks free from its cradle. It obeys no master, and its disgust for earthly creatures weakness only grows with time.

name: Divine Champion
description: Untouchable by most conventional and magical weapons, this divine warrior wields a sword with lightning speed, deflecting both arrows and spells alike. He is the champion of choice to face any adversary, even those of divine power.

name: Divine Duelist
description: A duelist of unmatched skill in single combat, this warrior—born perhaps once in a generation—wields a sword so swift that his strikes are over before they’re even seen, cutting down opponents with imperceptible speed.

name: Drake Rider
description: Only legendary riders could hope to ever tame a drake and learn how to ride it. This deadly duo will ignite the battlefield while hunting down the few survivors with deadly arrows.

name: Eidolon
description: An ethereal embodiment of divine melody, wielding godlike power to protect his allies, able to rally armies to reshape whole kingdoms.

name: Eldritch Alchemist
description: Transcending the border between mortal and divine, her potions incorporate an eldritch god\'s blessing, obtained through arcane means and without its knowledge.

name: Elemental Alchemist
description: A brilliant mind who devoted her life to the study of Thaumaturgy, she has successfully replicated elemental magic in her potions using only natural ingredients and chemical processes.

name: Esoteric Alchemist
description: This masterful alchemist not only succeeded in harnessing the power of the elements in her creations but also infused them with blessings typically linked to benevolent deities.

name: Eternal Fortress
description: A legendary warrior whose armor is unbreakable by conventional means. Able to duel with mortals and deities, able to withstand an unreal amount of damage before even flinching.

name: Fire Wizard
description: Amids the journey of discovery, the Fire Wizard learned to channel magic to emulate natural forces. Being the most dangerous of them all, he choose fire as the object of his studies.

name: Footman
description: A novice infantry unit. Lacks experience, but has received a brief training in the Royal Army.

name: Fury
description: With a rare mastery of the bow, she makes death rain on the battlefield in the form of the deadliest of arrows.

name: Golden Rider
description: This fearsome archer rides one of the last remaining Golden Drakes, a nearly extinct subspecies of the more common drake. Distinguished by its brilliant golden scales, the Golden Drake boasts greater strength and a fiercer, hotter flame than its kin.

name: Guard
description: Specialized in the surveillance of civilians or places of interest, guards are widely employed for the protection of sensitive objectives.

name: Hailstorm
description: Having developed an almost superhuman ability with her weapon, she hails arrows on enemy armies with such a speed that surviving is almost impossible

name: Heavenly Cantor
description: A divine musician able to change the fate of a war through his instrument. Not only he will empower his allies, but through a uniquely crafted music, he will make them immune to pain.

name: Hellish Sculptor
description: Half way between assassin and artist, he draws his target ever closer to death with each strike—leaving behind hauntingly beautiful tributes to Death itself in his wake.

name: Holy Knight
description: A knight devoted to the service of the Holy Temple, he is a protector of the righteous and a vanguard of justice, sworn to eradicate evil from every corner of the land.

name: Horse Rider
description: An archer who shifted the focus of her training to horse riding. Blends the danger of long-range attacks with the ability to deal melee damage with her ride.

name: Huntress
description: Refining her skills with her hunting experience in the wilderness, she can hit enemies with reliable shots.

name: Hurricane
description: This archer of unnatural precision is a coveted asset for any army. She can fend off a full-scale assault for hours, and can be reached only by sacrificing an enormous number of soldiers.

name: Infernal Lord
description: Ascending through infernal ranks through its ruthlessness and cruelty, an Infernal Lord walking the realms is a threat that brings enemy kingdoms together in a desperate effort to prevent the entire world\'s descent into chaos.

name: Infernal Prince
description: Rising from the ashes of conquest and tempered by the fires of countless battles, the Infernal Prince commands legions with a fearsome authority unmatched in the infernal realms. Now no longer a commander but a true sovereign of terror, the Infernal Prince stands as an unstoppable force, against whom resistance is little more than a fleeting hope.

name: Inferno
description: An incredibly powerful, mystical able to invoke firestorms out of thin air, burning entire armies to ashes while meteor falls upon them. An army that can reliably protect him is an army that can win any battle.

name: Inquisitor
description: As feared as he is respected, the Inquisitor\'s might is rarely matched. He stands as the supreme lawgiver, overseeing the realms conquered by the Holy Temple.

name: Iron Defender
description: An enormous warden capable of withstanding a substantial amount of damage before succumbing.

name: Iron Warden
description: A seasoned guard rich in experience, clad in a heavy armor.

name: Juggernaut
description: A rare sight in the battlefield, these armored giants can easily shrug off strikes from siege weapons with ease.

name: Justiciar
description: The Justiciar serves as the Holy Temple’s arbiter, enforcing laws that everyone—from peasants to kings—must obey to avoid incurring the Temple\'s wrath. A formidable warrior, he leads crusades against evil tyrants and unholy creatures that threaten the Realms.

name: King\'s Hand
description: The king\'s personal guard. Wreaks havoc during unrests, and singlehandedly guarantees His Majesty safety against any threat.

name: Knight
description: Renowned for their steadfast loyalty and honor, they provide a first line for their allies while overpowering their foes.

name: Lich
description: Through extraordinary willpower, the Lich endured his transformation for decades, without surrendering to the pain until only bare bones remained. Since muscles and tendons are long gone, this shell of a human is animated entirely by magic.

name: Light Disciple
description: An inexperienced mage who tries to expand his knowledge towards a branch of magic that does not hurt foes, but help allies.

name: Lorekeeper
description: The stories known by this keeper of ancient wisdom are almost endless. Drawing upon myths and legends, he channels forgotten magic through his instrument notes.

name: Lord of Decay
description: A demigod who mastered the control over death, capable of summoning terrifying monsters never seen before.

name: Marksman
description: Rigorous training coupled with a keen vision blessed the Marksman with a perfect aim, even in the most hostile conditions.

name: Meat Carver
description: Working like a seasoned sculptor he meticolously shapes his creation, one precise strike after another. The final outcome is a grim tribute to death itself.

name: Melting Elder
description: His blood and flesh turned into elemental fire. This incredibly powerful caster incinerates his enemies with a single gesture.

name: Minstrel
description: A gifted performer whose melodies inspire allies and mislead foes, turning the tides of a battle with a song or a whispered word.

name: Necromancer
description: Gifted with the magic of decay, antithesis of all that is holy. The Necromancer spells corrupt the flesh of his enemies and condemns them to an afterlife of servitude.

name: Night Blade
description: He adapted to darkness like a nocturnal animal. Campfire stories about them can make the night uneasy for any exploration team in foreign lands.

name: Night Lament
description: Halfway between mortal and divine, entire cults were born to worship this force of death. Its presence in the darkness is revealed only by the laments of its victims.

name: Night Specter
description: Blending seamlessly with the night\'s terrain, in the cover of darkness, no human stands a chance against his ambush.

name: Night Terror
description: Ancient myths speak of Night Terrors, and how entire villages could vanish overnight because the wrong person was crossed.

name: Night Veil
description: Indistinguishable from the shadows that envelop its prey, every enemy—no matter how powerful—falls before they even sense its approach.

name: Overlord
description: A ruthless ruler who respects no laws but his own. He will stop at nothing to eliminate his enemies and conquer rival kingdoms.

name: Paladin
description: An elite warrior of the Holy Temple, a beacon of light to the oppressed, upholds and enforces the laws of the kingdom.

name: Plague Spreader
description: Equipped with one of the strongest venom known to humanity, she can propagate deadly illnesses among the enemy ranks.

name: Poison Bow
description: An expert archer who studied the art of poison mixing, she imbues her arrows with an unknown substance capable of weakening enemies.

name: Radiant Elder
description: Blessed with ancient knowledge and divine powers, few recorded instances of Radiant Elders are present in history books. They are exceptional healers, said to be able to bring anyone back from the brink of death.

name: Red Archmage
description: Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. Decades of training made this mage able to effortlessly wield fire magic to set his enemies ablaze.

name: Red Elder
description: Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. The Red Elder conjure meteors above the enemy ranks, dealing tremendous damage in a large area.

name: Red Mage
description: An experienced mage who can harness his powers to hurl fireballs into the enemy ranks. Can be often found in the ranks of defending armies, being a deterrent for any aggressor choosing to invade through an open field.

name: Red Stalker
description: A master of lethality, he waits for the best moment to strike with incredible precision inflicting a grievous wound that hardly heals.

name: Rogue
description: An outcast who resorts to petty crimes to survive. Lacking in strength and cunning, he compensates with his streetwise knowledge and resourcefulness.

name: Royal Captain
description: The most skilled swordsman serving the royal family ascends to the role of Captain, overseeing palace security and determining the strategic tactics to be employed.

name: Royal Guard
description: Commonly found in noble houses and palaces, these guards offer a balanced blend of offensive and defensive capabilities.

name: Royal Swordsman
description: Highly trained in the art of swordsmanship, these guards are usually assigned to the protection of royal families and their palace.

name: Scorching Elder
description: A mythological entity who became one with the flame. The Scorched Elder conjures searing flames so powerful they can melt rocks, and crushes his enemies with the strength of a small star.

name: Scourge
description: A force of nature capable of reshaping the borders of kingdoms. It\'s said his devastating strikes can annihilate entire legions.

name: Shadow Crawler
description: Specialized in concealment within the shadows, the Shadow Crawler can be very hard to hit in dark areas

name: Shadow Dancer
description: Uses darkness as his hideout, and strike enemies when they least expect it.

name: Silver Tongue
description: A persuasive manipulator who bends hearts and minds, able to inspire his allies and push them over their limits.

name: Skeleton
description: A reanimated skeleton. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.

name: Spire Acolyte
description: Acolytes, as full-fledged members of the Spire, have mastered the organization\'s secret technique. They are pivotal agents dispatched across the Realms, ensuring no target is beyond the reach of the Spire.

name: Spire Initiate
description: The Spire, an age-old clandestine organization, recruits only the realm\'s most skilled assassins. Its select few members wield profound influence over the political landscape of kingdoms, capable of eliminating virtually any target with a secretive technique known solely to them.

name: Spire Leader
description: Upon the passing of the former Spire leader, often under circumstances far from the natural, the most experienced Acolyte is entrusted with assuming their role, and the organization\'s deepest secrets are revealed to them. Deployed only for exceptionally difficult tasks, and throughout history, they have been credited with toppling rulers and deities alike.

name: Spire Sage
description: Spire Sages are those who advance the lethal techniques of the spire assassins. New Sages may not emerge for centuries, as the cynical resolve needed to pursue such knowledge is extremely uncommon.

name: Spirit Engraver
description: This one-of-a-kind assassin, gifted with unparalleled skill, can strike at the very essence of a being\'s consciousness, reaching beyond mere flesh. No living creature, mortal or divine, is safe from his dark art.

name: Spitfang Rider
description: Displaying an incredible riding ability, Spitfang Riders managed to tame the fearsome Spitfang Snakes, a fearsome beast that can attack from a distance.

name: Sureshot
description: A master of archery, a Sureshot with a good positioning can take out even small groups of enemies all by herself.

name: Tempest
description: Bane of invading armies, the Tempest will haul barrages of arrows shot with devastating strength and precision, singlehandedly defending strategic hideouts from entire regiments.

name: Templar
description: Among the strongest crusaders of the Holy Temple, the Templar serves as a commander of the vanguard that enforces the law in undiscovered lands.

name: Thief
description: A nimble outlaw whose skills are invaluable for detecting dangers well in advance.

name: Titan
description: An unbreakable warrior, renowned for traversing the chaos of battle unscathed. Whole armies have attempted, yet failed, to inflict even the slightest injury upon him.

name: Toxic Stalker
description: The Toxic Stalker has perfected her art of creating deadly toxins, and can severely disrupt the activity of unaware hostile entities.

name: Trickster
description: A cunning rogue who thrives on deception, adept at distracting foes and seizing unexpected opportunities in the chaos of battle.

name: Tyrant
description: A leader capable of unspeakable evil, he stands as the unrivaled champion in realms where only the mightiest prevail.

name: Unchained
description: Most of those who aspire to become a Lich through the forgotten rituals realize too late they cannot pay the price required. The necromancer who begs for the release of death is confronted with a grim offer: his mortal body as an instrument for the entities he communed with.

name: Undying Bastion
description: A walking, impenetrable fortress clad in unbreakable battle gear. Deployed in epic battles to stabilize the frontline on newly conquered lands, he is able to withstand a full charge from opposing armies alone.

name: Warrior
description: An infantry unit with some experience in the battlefield. Warriors constitutes the bulk of regular armies.

name: Whisper
description: Mythological beings from whom the Spire assassins appear to draw their powers, they exist on the boundary between realms, slaying their prey through mysterious means.

name: White Archmage
description: Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. With their exceptional mastery of white magic, White Archmages are strategic units that can turn the tides of a battle.

name: White Elder
description: Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. White elders unleash an unending stream of healing, making any frontline extremely resilient.

name: White mage
description: Widely used in the ranks of any army, white mages divisions provide reliable healing from the backlines to the most exposed soldiers.

name: Wolf Rider
description: Not indicated for beginner riders, wolves provide a formidable companion that can viciously bite enemies already overwhelmed by arrows.

name: Worg Rider
description: An extremely vicious beast, the worg will tear apart the flesh of its enemies while his rider shoots with deadly aim.

name: Wounds Weaver
description: Unparalleled in the knowledge of anatomy, his enemies are a living canvas to him. While victim\'s realization rises with each stroke, his art comes to life while life comes to an end.

name: Wraith
description: Gradually altered by constant exposure to various toxins, she has developed complete immunity to poison. This venomous demon slips through enemy towns under cover of night, hidden in shadows, leaving soldiers helpless before the coming invasion.

name: Wyrm Rider
description: Wyrms are colossal, legendary creatures famed for the chaos they unleash in myths and folklore. These magical beasts possess elemental breath powerful enough to level entire towns, which led to them being relentlessly hunted in centuries past. No human has ever been known to ride a wyrm—except, perhaps, in the tales told by bards.

name: Zombie
description: A reanimated zombie. It feels no pain, so physical damage is less effective.
